units.text: IDEA: Reword to "In R003 the deciding information was not public; in R001 the opportunity was too small to test."
IDEA: Label the "Why" column "INFERENCE" for both rows.
IDEA: Replace with "no mid-word breaks, no page scroll at 320, 375 and 1280 px; one tall-row item open; readability not user-tested".
IDEA: Reword the recommendation to "PAUSED_NEEDS_HELP: owner chooses among a one-shot MILBFA confirmatory test (low expected value), a feasibility check of MiLB promotion timing, or stopping."
IDEA: Add "acceptance also falsely rejected a passing tree three times (DOG-044)" to the review-effectiveness list.

IDEA: Reword the opening conclusion to: "Two public-data candidates (MILBFA, SENDHOLD) did not show an advantage over simple baselines. For SENDHOLD the deciding information (play-level tracking) is not in the public feed. For MILBFA the pre-registered segment was too small (12-23 contributors a year, below 30), and no model was fitted for it."

IDEA: Replace the recommendation with: "Campaign state PAUSED_NEEDS_HELP. Options for the owner: stop; non-public data; a one-shot pre-registered MILBFA confirmatory test on the unused 2025 holdout (new feature hypothesis required, expected value small); or Howl-only regression on CUBS-P-009, -011, -012 and NOTE-010."

IDEA: Add a one-row-per-run table: run ID, type, prompt version, outcome (COMPLETE_NEGATIVE, COMPLETE_REGRESSION, COMPLETE_NEGATIVE, COMPLETE_USEFUL, COMPLETE_USEFUL), delivery state, and "baseball claim: yes or no".

IDEA: Mark the INFERENCE items inside the results table as INFERENCE (the 96% explanation and the "obvious rule" explanation), and fix the R003 call count (27 of 40) and the DOG-042 live-proof statement.
